value.rationale: This canonical 15-point thick generalized quadrangle is the smallest proper generalized quadrangle and a standard test case for finite polar incidence. Its doubled-line concept family exhibits a sharp VC/Littlestone separation (4 versus 5), has a nonpure shattering complex whose lower maximal faces are exactly the geometric lines, and has homology in two dimensions. The invariant package is structural and finite but not a gratuitous arbitrary numeric slice; it identifies the interaction of incidence geometry, restricted Boolean OR learning and topology.
